description: 97% of union workers at a JBS-owned meat processing plant in Denver voted to authorize a strike, citing unfair labor practices, retaliation, and dangerous working conditions. The vote follows a historic three-week strike at JBS's Greeley plant — the first major meatpacking strike in 40 years.

mainImage.alt: Group of striking meatpacking workers standing together holding protest signs outside the JBS plant
mainImage.caption: Workers from the JBS beef plant in Colorado protest across the road from the facility during ongoing strike action

seo.description: 97% of workers at JBS Denver plant authorize strike. First major meatpacking strikes in 40 years expose corporate abuse and monopoly power.
seo.title: Denver JBS Strike: Meatpacking Workers Fight Back

title: Meatpacking Workers Say Enough: Denver Strike Vote Is the Latest Front in the War on Corporate Meat
